You can tell how proud she was of him 🥹♥️

Before her passing in 2007, Donda West was one of Kanye West’s biggest supporters, and footage of her hyping him after a show in New York captures that bond perfectly. She proudly praised her son’s performance, showing just how much she believed in his talent and everything he had worked to accomplish.

The moment feels especially genuine because Donda was never just celebrating Kanye’s success. She understood how hard he had worked to get there and was always there to remind him of how special his talent was. Her encouragement became an important part of Kanye’s confidence as he continued growing into one of the biggest artists in the world.

Donda’s influence remained deeply connected to Kanye’s music and career even after her death in November 2007. Her support, guidance, and belief in her son became a lasting part of his story, making moments like this even more meaningful when looking back at Kanye’s rise to fame.
